story.title: Successful login
story.narrative: As a registered shopper, I want to log in with my username and password so that I can browse the products.
criteria: Given I am on the login page
When I log in as "standard_user" with password "secret_sauce"
Then I am taken to the inventory page (URL ends with /inventory.html)
And the page title reads "Products"
And exactly 6 products are listed

story.title: Locked-out user is rejected
story.narrative: As the shop owner, I want locked accounts to be refused so that blocked users cannot place orders.
criteria: Given I am on the login page
When I log in as "locked_out_user" with password "secret_sauce"
Then I stay on the login page
And an error message says "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out."

story.title: Wrong password is rejected
story.narrative: As a shopper, I want a clear message when my credentials are wrong so that I know to retry.
criteria: Given I am on the login page
When I log in as "standard_user" with password "not_the_password"
Then an error message says "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service"
And the username and password fields are still visible

story.narrative: As a logged-in shopper, I want to log out so that the next person on this computer cannot use my session.
criteria: Given I am logged in as "standard_user"
When I open the menu and choose "Logout"
Then I am back on the login page
And the login button is visible
